title: 3: Physiographic Divisions of Ethiopia
content: 3.2.2. The Southeastern Highlands and Lowlands (የደቡብ ምስራቅ ደጋ እና ቆላማ ቦታዎች)
እንኳን ወደ ትምህርታችን በደህና መጣችሁ! በዚህ ክፍል ስለ ደቡብ ምስራቅ ደጋ እና ቆላማ ቦታዎች፣ ስለ ስምጥ ሸለቆ እንዲሁም ስለ መሬት አቀማመጥ ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ተፅዕኖዎች በጋራ እንማራለን። መልካም የጥናት ጊዜ ይሁንላችሁ!
📌 Second largest physiographic region in Ethiopia, covering 37% of the total land area.
📌 Divided into two main landscape types: Highlands (46%) and Lowlands (54%).
📌 Boundaries: Bordered on the west and north by the steep eastern escarpment of the Rift Valley:
📌 Topographic Slope: Drops abruptly from the plateau edge into the Rift Valley, then gradually descends southeastward toward the Somali plain.
📌 Subdivided into two highland units and two extensive lowland units.
👉 <font color="#00B0FF">ይህ ክልል የኢትዮጵያ ሁለተኛው ትልቁ የመሬት አቀማመጥ ሲሆን 37% የሚሆነውን የአገሪቱን ስፋት ይሸፍናል። 46% ደጋ እና 54% ቆላ በመሆን የተከፈለ ነው።</font>
🎯 Exam Hint: የደቡብ ምስራቅ ክልል የሀገሪቱን ስንት ፐርሰንት እንደሚያካልል (37%) እና የደጋና ቆላ ድርሻውን (46% highlands vs 54% lowlands) በደከመ መልኩ ለፈተና ያዝ ያድርጉት!
A. The Arsi-Bale-Sidama Highlands (የአርሲ-ባሌ-ሲዳማ ደጋማ ቦታዎች)
📌 Located in the southwestern section of the region, accounting for 28.5% of the region's area and 62% of the Southeastern Highlands.
📌 Arsi Highlands: Consist of flat rolling uplands and dissected mountain peaks.
• Mount Kaka: 4,180 m.a.s.l
• Mount Bada: 4,139 m.a.s.l
• Mount Chilalo: 4,036 m.a.s.l
📌 Bale Highlands: Separated from Arsi by the headstream of the Wabishebelle River.
• Features a basaltic plateau in the north-central and high mountain massifs in the south.
• Contains the Sanetti Plateau (Afro-Alpine summit).
• Highest peaks: Tulu-Demtu (4,377 m.a.s.l) and Mount Batu (4,307 m.a.s.l).
👉 <font color="#00B0FF">የአርሲ እና ባሌ ተራሮች በዋቢሸበሌ ወንዝ ይለያያሉ። ቱሉ ዲምቱ (4,377 ሜትር) በዚሁ ክልል ውስጥ የሚገኝ ከፍተኛ ተራራ ነው።</font>
🎯 Exam Hint: የአርሲ እና ባሌ ተራሮችን የሚለያየው የትኛው ወንዝ እንደሆነ (Wabishebelle River) እና የባሌ ተራራዎች ከፍተኛው ጫፍ (Tulu-Demtu - 4,377m) ማን እንደሆነ በተደጋጋሚ በፈተና ላይ ይመጣሉ!
Sidama Highlands & Geological Wonders (የሲዳማ ደጋ እና የተፈጥሮ ድንቆች)
📌 Sidama Highlands: Located in the southwestern corner, separated from Bale by the Ghenale River Valley.
• Prominent feature: Jemjem Plateau, famous for coffee production.
📌 Drainage & Erosion: Dissected by the Wabishebelle and Ghenale river systems.
• Features Pleistocene glaciation erosion (trough-like gorges, hanging valleys).
📌 Sof Omar Cave System:
• Carved by the Weyb River (tributary of Ghenale) through Mesozoic Limestone rocks.
• One of the world's most spectacular underground caverns accessible by an underground stream.
📌 Economic Significance: Highly productive major grain-producing area with immense potential.
👉 <font color="#00B0FF">የሶፍ ዑመር ዋሻ በወይብ ወንዝ አማካይነት በሜሶዞይክ ኖራ ድንጋይ (Mesozoic Limestone) ውስጥ የተሸረሸረ ድንቅ የተፈጥሮ ዋሻ ነው።</font>
🎯 Exam Hint: የሶፍ ዑመር ዋሻ (Sof Omar Cave) በየትኛው ወንዝ (Weyb River) እና በየትኛው የድንጋይ አይነት (Mesozoic Limestone) እንደተፈጠረ በፈተና ላይ የማጣመር (Matching) ወይም ምርጫ ጥያቄ ሆኖ ሊመጣ ይችላል!
B. The Hararghe Plateau (የሐረርጌ አምባምድር)
📌 Extends northeasterly from the Chercher Highlands to Jigjiga.
📌 Makes up 38% of the Southeastern Highlands and 17.4% of the whole physiographic region.
📌 Has the smallest proportion of upper highland (>2,000 meters) among the highland units.
📌 Topography: Low-lying, elongated region that rises sharply from the Rift Valley floor and gently descends southeastward.
📌 Drained by the left-bank tributaries of the Wabishebelle River.
📌 Geology: Trappean lava is largely eroded, leaving Mesozoic rocks extensively exposed.
📌 Highest Peak: Mount Gara-Muleta (3,381 m.a.s.l).
👉 <font color="#00B0FF">የሐረርጌ አምባምድር ዝቅተኛ እና ረጅም ቅርፅ ያለው ሲሆን ከፍተኛው ተራራ ጋራ ሙለታ (3,381 ሜትር) ይባላል።</font>
🎯 Exam Hint: የሐረርጌ አምባምድር ከፍተኛው ተራራ Mount Gara-Muleta (3,381m) መሆኑን እና ከሌሎቹ የደጋ ክፍሎች አነስተኛ የከፍተኛ ቦታ (Upper Highland) ድርሻ ያለው መሆኑን ያጥኑ!
The Southeastern Lowlands (የደቡብ ምስራቅ ቆላማ ቦታዎች)
📌 Most extensive lowlands in Ethiopia, accounting for 54% of the region and ~20% (one-fifth) of the nation's total land area.
📌 Subdivided into two major plains:
• Wabishebelle Plain (60%)
• Ghenale Plain (40%)
📌 Includes the plains of Ogaden, Elkere, and Borena.
📌 Terrain: Southeastward sloping plains, interrupted by low hills, inselbergs, broad river valleys, and depressions.
📌 Human Settlement: Sparsely populated by pastoral and semi-pastoral communities due to harsh dry climate.
📌 Economic Potential: Animal husbandry, potential for large-scale irrigation, and reserves of petroleum and natural gas.
👉 <font color="#00B0FF">የደቡብ ምስራቅ ቆላማ ቦታዎች የሀገሪቱን አንድ አምስተኛ (20%) ይሸፍናሉ። በዋናነት የእንስሳት እርባታ እና የፔትሮሊየም/ተፈጥሮ ጋዝ እምቅ ሀብት አላቸው።</font>
🎯 Exam Hint: የደቡብ ምስራቅ ቆላማ ቦታዎች የሀገሪቱን 1/5ኛ (20%) እንደሚያካልሉ እና የሚታወቁበትን ዋና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ሀብት (Petroleum and Natural Gas reserves) ማስታዎስ ይጠበቅባችኃል🙆‍♂️!
3.2.3. The Rift Valley (የስምጥ ሸለቆ)
📌 A tectonically formed structural depression bounded by parallel escarpments.
📌 Physically splits the Ethiopian Highlands and Lowlands into two main sections.
📌 Extends 1,700 km from the Afar Triangle in the north down to Chew Bahir in the south.
📌 Covers 18% of Ethiopia's total surface area.
📌 Shape & Orientation: Elongated, funnel-shaped depression oriented in a NE-SW direction (widest at Afar, narrowing southward).
📌 Floor Features: Grabs, tectonic sags, volcanic domes, cinder cones, lacustrine, and fluvial deposits.
📌 Elevation Extremes: Ranging from -125 m below sea level (Dallol) to 2,000 m.a.s.l (Lakes region).
👉 <font color="#00B0FF">ስምጥ ሸለቆ በቴክቶኒክ እንቅስቃሴ የተፈጠረ ዝቅተኛ መሬት ሲሆን የኢትዮጵያን ደጋ እና ቆላ ቦታዎች በሁለት ይከፍላል።</font>
🎯 Exam Hint: የስምጥ ሸለቆ አጠቃላይ ርዝመት (1,700 km)፣ የሀገሪቱን የቆዳ ስፋት ድርሻ (18%) እና አቅጣጫው (NE-SW) ለፈተና በጣም አስፈላጊ ናቸው! አይዟችሁ እየጨረስን ነው 💪
i. The Afar Triangle (የአፋር ትሪያንግል)
📌 Largest and widest division of the Rift Valley (54% of the Rift Valley area).
📌 Bounded by the Western & Eastern Escarpments and the Afar/Aisha Horst.
📌 General elevation: 300 to 700 meters.
📌 Danakil Depression (Kobar Sink):
• Separated from the Red Sea by a 200m high land barrier.
• Lake Asal: Sits at 125 meters below sea level—the lowest point on the African continent.
• Extremely hostile climate with summer temperatures exceeding 50°C at Dallol.
📌 Features & Lakes: Contains active volcanoes, lava fields, salt plains, and lakes (Abe, Asale, Afrera).
📌 Economic Potential: Salt extraction, Awash River irrigation, and geothermal energy.
👉 <font color="#00B0FF">አፋር ትሪያንግል የስምጥ ሸለቆው ትልቁ ክፍል ሲሆን (54%)፣ የአፍሪካ አህጉር ዝቅተኛው ቦታ የሆነውን የአሳል ሀይቅን (-125 ሜ) ይዟል።</font>
🎯 Exam Hint: የአፍሪካ አህጉር ዝቅተኛው ቦታ የትኛው እንደሆነ (Lake Asal / Dallol at -125m below sea level) በፈተና ላይ የመምጣት እድሉ በጣም ከፍተኛ ነው!
ii. Main Ethiopian Rift & iii. Chew Bahir Rift (ማዕከላዊው እና የቸዉ ባሂር ስምጥ ሸለቆ)
📌 Main Ethiopian Rift (MER) / Central Rift:
• Extends from Awash River (north) to Lake Chamo (south).
• Narrowest and highest section of the Rift Valley (width: 50-80 km; elevation: 1,000-2,000 m).
• Notable volcanic peaks: Mt. Fentale, Boseti-guda, Aletu, Chebi.
• Features tectonic lakes, rain-fed agriculture, tourism, and geothermal potential.
📌 Chew Bahir Rift:
• Smallest and southernmost segment of the Rift Valley.
• Separated from the MER by the Gneissic highlands of Konso.
• Characterized by a broad, marshy depression into which the Segen and Woito streams drain.
👉 <font color="#00B0FF">ማዕከላዊው የስምጥ ሸለቆ ክፍል ሀይቆችን እና ተራሮችን የያዘ ሲሆን፣ ጨዉ ባህር ደግሞ በደቡብ በኩል የሚገኝ ረግራጋማ ቦታ ነው።</font>
🎯 Exam Hint: Chew Bahir Rift አነስተኛው እና ደቡባዊው ክፍል መሆኑን እንዲሁም ከማዕከላዊው ስምጥ ሸለቆ የሚለየው በኮንሶ ተራሮች (Gneissic highlands of Konso) መሆኑን ያዙ!
3.3. Socioeconomic Impacts of Relief (የመሬት አቀማመጥ ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ተፅዕኖ)
📌 1. Agriculture Practices:
• Farm Structure: Rugged landscapes force farms to be small, fragmented, and irregular.
• Techniques: Mechanized farming is difficult on steep hillsides.
• Crops: High altitude suits barley & wheat; low altitude suits sorghum & maize.
• Livestock: Equines/sheep thrive in highlands; camels/goats adapt to lowlands.
📌 2. Settlement Patterns:
• Highlands: High density, sedentary, permanent settlements (temperate, malaria-free).
• Lowlands: Low density, temporary settlements of nomadic pastoralists.
📌 3. Transportation & Infrastructure:
• Deep gorges, waterfalls, and steep cliffs make rivers non-navigable and isolate communities.
• Mountainous terrain drastically increases road construction and telecommunication costs.
👉 <font color="#00B0FF">የመሬት አቀማመጥ በግብርናው፣ በህዝብ አሰፋፈር እና በትራንስፖርት ግንባታ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተፅዕኖ ያሳድራል።</font>
📌 4. Hydroelectric Power (HEP): Steep elevation drops combined with high rainfall create enormous HEP generation potential.
📌 5. Socio-Cultural Identity: Historical isolation created rich cultural diversity. Inhabitants self-identify as Degegnas (mountaineers) vs Kollegnas (lowlanders).
📌 6. Climate Influence: Tropical location paired with altitude creates moisture-surplus highlands vs moisture-deficit lowlands.
📌 7. Soil Development: Steep mountain slopes cause high runoff and soil erosion, forming shallow, poorly developed soils.
📌 8. Natural Vegetation: Temperature and precipitation gradients directly determine vegetation zones across altitudes.
👉 <font color="#00B0FF">የከፍታ ልዩነት የሃይድሮ ኤሌክትሪክ ሃይል እምቅ አቅምን የሚፈጥር ሲሆን፣ የደጋ እና ቆላ ነዋሪዎች ባህላዊ መገለጫዎች እንዲፈጠሩም ምክንያት ሆኗል።</font>
🎯 Exam Hint: የመሬት አቀማመጥ በሰብል አይነት (ደጋ = Wheat/Barley፣ ቆላ = Maize/Sorghum) እና በህዝብ አሰፋፈር (ደጋ = Sedentary፣ ቆላ = Nomadic) ላይ የሚያሳድረው ተፅዕኖ በምርጫ ጥያቄዎች ላይ ይደጋገማል!
Chapter_3 በዚሁ አበቃ። በነገራችን ላይ የሚድ ፈተናችሁ ብዙ ጊዜ የሚያጠቃልለው እስከዚህ ነው። በቀጣይ 🚴🏼‍♂️🚴🏽‍♀️ ወደ Chapter_4 እንሄዳለን!
